{{Top}}
[[File:Republic_Emblem.svg|thumb|right|200px|The Galactic Roundel]]
The '''Republic crest''' was an eight-rayed stellar symbol centered in a circle whose circumference was made up of dashed lines. The Republic crest was one of many seals of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
The Republic crest,<ref name="Keeping the Peace">''[[Keeping the Peace]]''</ref> also known as the Galactic Roundel,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|311|galactic roundel}}</ref> dates back 1000 generations to the [[Order of Dai Bendu|Bendu monks]]. In their study of numerology, they believed that the number nine signified the beneficent presence of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] in a united [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. The [[Bendu symbol]] was meant to represent the number nine with its eight spokes joined to one disc.<ref name="CCS">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref> The [[Tho Yor]] were also decorated with a symbol reminiscent of the Bendu symbol.<ref name="DOJ1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]]</ref> The Bendu symbol eventually became the symbol of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="CCS" />

During the [[Krath Holy Crusade]], [[Fleet Captain/Legends|Fleet Captain]] [[Orley Vanicus]] had a nine-spoked symbol on his helmet.<ref name="DarkLords">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 2]]</ref>  The [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] used a similar nine-spoked symbol on their ships during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]],<ref name="SithWar">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 1]]</ref> as did [[Khoonda]] during the [[First Jedi Purge]].<ref name="KOTOR II">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

Later on, the Galactic Roundel once again had become the symbol of the Republic and unity. One called the [[Insignia of Unity]] was placed on the podium of the [[Grand Convocation Chamber|Galactic Senate Rotunda]] and up until [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Declaration of a New Order|declaration of the Galactic Empire]], one adorned the [[Hall of Justice (Alderaan)|Hall of Justice]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="Falcon">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>

In [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]] the Rotunda had undergone a desperate renovation at which point the emblem that sat on the podium was replaced by a counterfeit. The counterfeit was placed by the [[Republic Group/Legends|Republic Group]] who believed the symbol could be used to reawaken and rouse those who had fallen under Palpatine's sway. The Republic Group had the symbol moved to [[Tandun III]] for safe keeping.<ref name="Falcon" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] numerous Republic vehicles and vessels were marked with the Galactic Roundel. Some of these vessels included the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Republic Gunship]] and the [[Unstable Terrain Artillery Transport/Legends|UT-AT]]. The symbol was also used on the [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Jedi Starfighter]] and [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Jedi Interceptor]].<ref name="CCS" /> During the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]'s [[Anakin Skywalker's Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|customized interceptor]] had a six-spoked version of the Galactic Roundel on it.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] the Republic Group had started to worry about the dark direction the Republic was now taking. The group decided it was time to re-relieve the icon they had hidden on Tandun III to the galaxy, hoping it would restore Republic honor. They tasked [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tobb Jadak]] with delivering the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Stellar Envoy'']] to an [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Ranger]] named [[Aren Folee]]. Folee was then to use the ''Stellar Envoy'' to retrieve the "treasure". After a debacle with the [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]], Captain Jadak was critically injured and the ''Stellar Envoy'' was lost preventing the Republic Group from completing their mission. The knowledge of this mission would be locked away in Jadak's memories while he was in a coma and the truth about the insignia would only be known by [[Lestra Oxic]] for decades.<ref name="Falcon" />

Following the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] would change the Galactic Roundel by the removal of two spikes; the resulting icon was the [[Imperial crest/Legends|Imperial crest]].<ref name="CCS" />

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], and [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]] in [[43 ABY]], during a quest to learn the history of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], had finally discovered the history of the Galactic Roundel that was removed from the Senate Rotunda decades earlier. Led to Tandun III by the Millennium Falcon and the now reawaken Tobb Jadak the Solo's found the insignia and learned its history from Lestra Oxic who followed them there. The insignia on Tandun III, much like its companion in the Rotunda, was a fake and the location of the real icon was never discovered.<ref name="Falcon" />
